verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one: the docs and GitHub material cover only streaming, touch and keyboard input, the clipboard, window management, pairing and connectivity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
